services.value: SPL provides energy laboratory testing (hydrocarbon, fuels, lubricants and aviation testing, along with flow assurance studies), environmental laboratory testing (drinking water, wastewater, groundwater, soil, and solid waste analysis including PFAS, dioxin, and QACs), and measurement services (gas and liquid measurement including meter proving, calibration, automation, production allocation, and emissions support). The site also lists sample collection and SureVue/WebLDS support.
